trap.label: phrasal come
trap.wrong: I came across with an old photo.
trap.right: I came across an old photo.
trap.why: Em português “deparei-me com” leva com. Em inglês, come across é transitivo direto: sem with.

mcq.q: I ___ an old photo. (found by chance)

opts: She came up with a plan.
She came with up a plan.

fix.wrong: I came across with a photo.

fix.right: She came up with a plan.

fix.wrong: He came up of an idea.
fix.right: He came up with an idea.

rewrite.prompt: Use come across: “I found an old photo by chance.”
rewrite.answer: I came across an old photo.

rewrite.prompt: Use come up with: “She proposed an idea.”
rewrite.answer: She came up with an idea.
